name: World of Corruption
source: You play as a young man whose life takes a sudden turn after a mysterious event grants him the ability to influence people in ways he never could before. What begins as curiosity quickly becomes something deeper and darker.
translation: 你将扮演一名年轻男子：一场神秘事件骤然改变了他的人生轨迹，赋予了他以前所未有的方式左右他人的能力。起初只是出于好奇的尝试，很快便演变成了更深沉、更黑暗的欲望。
